view: PA (frontal), L marker at patient's left shoulder confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate penetration and inspiration; both apices and costophrenic angles included. Thorax markedly rotated/asymmetric because of severe instrumented thoracolumbar scoliosis; spinal hardware overlaps the mediastinum and paraspinal lung; breast shadows overlie both lower zones. Interpretation of the lung bases is limited.

devices.type: Posterior spinal fusion instrumentation (two longitudinal rods with multiple pedicle screws/hooks and a transverse connector) for scoliosis
devices.location: Midline/paraspinal, spanning approximately upper thoracic (T2-T3) to lower lumbar (L3-L4) spine
Image upper right, over the patient's left shoulder
Over the patient's left shoulder, just medial to the L marker

abnormalities.finding: Hazy, ill-defined increased opacity in the medial/paracardiac right lower zone above the elevated right hemidiaphragm, partially obscuring the right heart border; possible right middle/lower lobe consolidation vs. compressive atelectasis from scoliosis and diaphragm elevation (uncertain)
Severe thoracolumbar scoliosis, status post posterior instrumented fusion, with rotation of the thorax
Elevated right hemidiaphragm with crowded right-sided ribs (small right hemithorax)
Mediastinum and cardiac silhouette displaced to the left; left hemithorax relatively large and hyperlucent (secondary to scoliosis/rotation); cardiac size not reliably assessable
Faint hazy density in the left lower zone lateral to the cardiac apex, indeterminate; likely overlapping breast/soft-tissue shadow rather than true consolidation

description_zh: 胸部正面片顯示嚴重胸腰椎側彎並已接受後位脊椎內固定手術（雙側縱向桿及多個椎弓根螺釘/鉤，範圍約自上胸椎至下腰椎），胸廓明顯旋轉不對稱，縱膈與心影向左偏移，右側橫膈抬高、右側肋骨擁擠。右下肺野內側靠近心緣處可見邊界不清的淡薄增加密度，右心緣部分模糊，可能為右中/下葉肺炎實變，但亦不排除因脊椎側彎及橫膈抬高造成的壓迫性肺不張，判讀受限。左下肺野外側亦有輕微模糊密度，疑為乳房軟組織重疊。未見胸腔積液、氣胸，亦無胸管或其他導管；胃泡位於左橫膈下。
